The user wants to set the log level of `svc-coral-254` to `debug` and check the status of bucket `bucket-audit-1791`.
According to the runbook:
1. Read `/workspace/ticket-TCK-483452.txt` (Done).
2. GET `/api/services/svc-coral-254`.
3. POST `/api/tickets/TCK-483452/token` for a token.
4. POST `/api/services/svc-coral-254/log-level` with `level: debug` and the token.
5. Call `cloud_stat` for `bucket-audit-1791`.
6. Submit report.
